variant_to_regulation.eligible_development_use: A parent-bound supervised MPRA, allelic-direction, or retrieval head may be refit on locus-bundle-shuffled outer-training outcomes and scored out of fold.
variant_to_regulation.current_limitation: No nonsealed signed eQTL or ieQTL training source is registered. A shuffled primary signed-effect head cannot be invented, and GSE289173 outcomes remain sealed and unavailable for fitting.
variant_to_regulation.split: Merged native-build LD blocks, declared loci, exact and reverse-complement sequence identity, and largest-receptive-field boundary buffer remain unchanged.

typed_evidence_graph.eligible_development_use: Refit an exact parent supervised graph or evidence estimator on whole LD-locus plus gene-block label bundles shuffled among shape-compatible training blocks after complete pseudo-held-source removal.
typed_evidence_graph.current_limitation: The promoted graph, explicit tested-negative denominators, parent estimator, and enough exchangeable source and block groups do not exist.
typed_evidence_graph.split: Pseudo-held source family, native-build LD locus, gene block, source aliases, and graph derivatives remain intact.

perturbation_transfer.eligible_development_use: Refit an exact held-target-capable parent on target-level response bundles deterministically deranged among shape-compatible outer-training targets.
perturbation_transfer.current_limitation: Most registered deep perturbation models are incompatible with the wholly unseen noncoding target task, and no exact parent-bound negative-control RunSpec exists.
perturbation_transfer.split: Target locus, guide family, and all nested biological-replicate response rows move as one bundle; cells and guides never move independently.

gse281364.allowed_control_use: Locus-cross-fitted MPRA activity or allelic-direction parent heads only, with all four-replicate context outcome rows for a locus kept in one bundle.
prohibitions: No row-level barcode or allele shuffle.
No mixing HepG2, LX-2, control, PAOA, or TGF-beta assay contexts.
No claim that a shuffled outcome is a tested biological negative.

gse281160.allowed_control_use: Only after experimental replicates, custom reference, guide families, target loci, response axes, and evidence ontology are frozen. Target-level bundles preserve all nested replicate and guide structure.
prohibitions: Cells, guides, sequencing lanes, targets, and genes are not exchangeability or inferential units by themselves.
The 20 selected loci cannot be described as an unbiased source.
Nearest-gene reassignment cannot make a parent model held-target capable.

current_coloc_gwas.allowed_control_use: Only after corrected promotion and complete pseudo-source and held-block removal. Whole source-specific locus-gene label bundles may be shuffled in training; source and LD topology stays intact.
current_coloc_gwas.prohibition: Current provisional memberships, the Gene Catalog, and frozen 117 programs cannot define permutation strata, outcomes, or null expectations.

gse244832_and_gse296875.role: development features and assay-native training sources
gse244832_and_gse296875.allowed_control_use: Outcome-independent training-fold RNA, ATAC, sequence, and masks may remain features for an eligible parent. Only the parent's supervised outcome bundle is shuffled.
gse244832_and_gse296875.prohibition: Donors, nuclei, modalities, and same-nucleus or same-sample topology are never shuffled or split.

gse275483.allowed_control_use: True animal-held outcomes may score a frozen parent-bound negative control after mouse references and joins activate. They cannot fit the permutation, parent, target mapping, or ortholog output.
gse275483.prohibition: Cells are not exchangeable biological replicates, and the one fasting animal cannot define its own permutation stratum.

gse313774.allowed_control_use: Only score a fully frozen control prediction after the prediction commit and outcome opening. Its 33 expression profiles never enter shuffled training.
prohibitions: No fit, model selection, calibration, or permutation construction from chip outcomes.
Libraries are not cells or n=33 biological replicates.
CXCL1 and IL8 remain excluded; no resmetirom RNA arm exists.

gse289173.role: jointly sealed cell and QTL evaluator
gse289173.allowed_control_use: none under the current shuffled_outcome capability because signed cell-type eQTL effects are not an allowed endpoint
gse289173.prohibition: Do not open, permute, fit, calibrate, or tune against sealed eQTL or ieQTL outcomes.

exchangeability_and_missingness_firewall.training_only: Construct strata, deterministic mappings, outcome bundles, parent fits, supervised feature selection, hyperparameters, early stopping, and calibration entirely inside each outer-training role.
exchangeability_and_missingness_firewall.split_preservation: No outcome bundle crosses cohort family, outer role, donor or biological unit, assay, species, native build, LD block topology, gene block topology, target component arity, or frozen response schema.
exchangeability_and_missingness_firewall.held_labels: Development and sealed labels remain true and evaluator-only. Shuffling them would change the evaluation question and is prohibited.
exchangeability_and_missingness_firewall.missingness: Feature masks remain with features. Outcome eligibility and exact outcome-state masks move with the whole outcome bundle. Missing values never become zero and strata with fewer than two compatible groups are not_applicable.
exchangeability_and_missingness_firewall.no_adaptive_relaxation: Do not merge strata, change outcome bundles, drop difficult rows, or choose a permutation index after seeing control or real-model scores.

calibration_uncertainty_and_null_use.calibration: Refit any parent calibrator on cross-fitted shuffled training labels only. A shuffled control never calibrates the real model, estimates held prevalence, or chooses a threshold.
calibration_uncertainty_and_null_use.biological_uncertainty: Use the parent task's donor, biological-replicate or animal, LD-block, or two-way LD plus gene-block bootstrap inside each realized permutation.
calibration_uncertainty_and_null_use.permutation_variation: Permutation indices measure null-control variation only. They are not donors, replicates, model seeds, or independent hypotheses.
calibration_uncertainty_and_null_use.null_diagnostic: A control performing unexpectedly well triggers a halted leakage and exchangeability audit. It is not evidence for outcome-free predictability and is not repaired on the same evaluated source.
calibration_uncertainty_and_null_use.permutation_test: No permutation p-value is currently registered. A future test must predeclare count, tail, statistic, exchangeability, inapplicable handling, and plus-one correction.

selection_and_claim_firewall.leaderboard: May appear only in a clearly separated negative-control diagnostic table or band.
selection_and_claim_firewall.multiplicity: Does not add a champion hypothesis. Any prespecified permutation-null test has its own separate family.

reproducibility_contract.control_receipt: Hash parent checkpoint and fitted-state identities, all parent inputs, split groups, exchangeability strata, stable group IDs, permutation seed material, ordering, offsets, source-to-destination mapping, no-fixed-point proof, inapplicable groups, shuffled labels and masks, every refitted outcome-dependent artifact, predictions, and evaluator inputs.
